issue.body_normalized: ## Description When moving collapsed cells section up, the cells are added to the collapsed area. When moving it down against a following section, the cell disappear into the void. ## Reproduce 1. Watch/recreate https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d58e12ff-74a2-4089-ba91-8da92cf79409 2. See 1st and 2nd code cell correctly get merged into `first h2` when moving `first h2` up 3. See 1st and 2nd code cell disappear when moving `first h2` down 4. Refresh the page with F5 5. See that the missing cells reaper: ## Expected behavior (a) I think the users would prefer if moving `first h2` down moved the markdown cell with the heading and everything under it beyond the last cell of `second h2`. As far as I understand, this is what PR https://github.com/jupyterlab/jupyterlab/pull/18084 is attempting to do. (b) However, short-term (for backports to stable releases) it is acceptable for the 1st and 2nd code cell to just appear under `h1`. In any case no cell should be made invisible on move operation. ## Context - JupyterLab version: 4.5.7 - https://github.com/jupyterlab/jupyterlab/pull/18808 fixed a crash on moving collapsed cells - https://github.com/jupyterlab/jupyterlab/pull/18084 is going towards (a)

issue.title: Cells disappear when moving collapsed cells around

pull_request.body_normalized:
## References
Fixes #18991


## Code changes
Fixes a notebook rendering issue where cells could remain hidden after moving a collapsed heading. The move logic now restores view state to the correct post-move cell index and refreshes collapsed-heading visibility from the current notebook order, so stale hidden flags do not make cells disappear. Adds a focused widget test covering the collapsed heading move case.
